pages.lines:
Hello! We are overjoyed by your interest in our family camping resort and are happy to welcome you to our general information!
In the resort, we offer an assortment of campsite rentals, including nightly RV campsites, seasonal/yearly campsites, boat rentals, group campsites, cabin rentals, and more we will soon announce!
We ONLY offer reservations via our online booking engine for all campsites.
The primary camper reserving the campsite will be required to pay for the total duration of their unit's reservation.
SUBJECT TO $200 A DAY CANCELLATION FEE if cancelled within 14 days of arrival.
Each RV pays for their own camping duration upon the time of arrival.
PRICES
Prices for campsites range from $52 - $58 a night throughout the park; depending on the site's services and location will affect the price in some instances.
All reservations must be booked in advance online. A small booking fee is added to all online reservations.
Mini-Group & Group Bookings are subject to a deposit to "hold" the site until the reservation date. At arrival, each individual pays for the duration of stay and services.
For campers wanting to stay on a seasonal site with their unit, the price is $45 a night.
Additional Prices upon RV site ( if applicable): Boat Launch is $18 a day. If you bring your golf cart, it is $10 a day and subject to $100 deposit upon registration.
RV Checkout time is 11 am, and we do not allow late checkout!
DAY RATES
For those interested in popping out to use our beautiful beach or to visit with friends or family within the park, we charge $18.00 per vehicle for the day!
For those looking to use one of our boat launches within the Marina, we charge $25.00 per boat.
Staying in a family/friends unit is $23.00 a night per vehicle.
Prices are subject to change.
